task.title: Correct three verified stale counts in tools/roadmap/README.md and absorb the prior release bookkeeping
task.objective: Correct exactly three already-verified stale claims in tools/roadmap/README.md — the source registry sentence that still says "Thirteen sources ... Eleven are parsed; two are registered but not parsed" when lib/sources.mjs registers 14 with 11 parsed and 3 unparsed; the consistency-rule sentence that still asserts the ledger measures 61/4/1 when the measured tally is 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED; and the Verification section that still says 157 checks when verify:roadmap-dashboard runs more — and absorb into the same commit the legitimate lease-release bookkeeping left uncommitted by awkit-hygiene-0906 (docs/ai/contracts/active-lease.json, docs/ai/contracts/awkit-hygiene-0906.json, tools/roadmap/assignments.json). No verifier logic, parser or production source is altered to match README prose, no awkit-hygiene-0906 semantics are modified, no general README rewrite is performed, and no protected owner material is staged, edited, moved or reset.

acceptance.description: The tools/roadmap/README.md "What it reads" sentence states the registry's real cardinality — the number of entries in tools/roadmap/lib/sources.mjs SOURCES, split into parsed and registered-but-unparsed — measured from the registry itself and corroborated by the roadmap verifier's own source-count line. Only the count words change; the surrounding architecture description is left intact.

The tools/roadmap/README.md consistency-rule sentence states the ledger's measured PASS / NOT RUN / BLOCKED tally instead of the stale 61/4/1. Only the tally is replaced; no validation case status is changed and docs/testing/comprehensive-validation/RECORDER_REPORTS_SETTINGS_TEST_CASES.md is not edited.

The tools/roadmap/README.md Verification section states the number of checks verify:roadmap-dashboard actually runs, taken from an executed run of that verifier. scripts/verify-roadmap-dashboard.mjs is not modified to match the prose.

The awkit-hygiene-0906 lease-release bookkeeping is committed on main unchanged in meaning: the active-lease release record is the truthful one the release tool wrote, the awkit-hygiene-0906.json diff is an append to write_lease.history only with its push evidence, completion evidence and acceptance semantics untouched, and the tools/roadmap/assignments.json diff is a claim-only change — the completed awkit-hygiene-0906 claim removed or rotated in place to the successor task by the lease tool — with the owner $comment block and the AWKIT-SEC-005 claim intact. No protected owner path is staged.

completion.qa_basis: Every number written into tools/roadmap/README.md was measured twice by independent methods before the edit and re-confirmed after it: the source registry by reading lib/sources.mjs SOURCES directly (14 registered / 11 parsed / 3 unparsed) and by the verifier's own 'OK 14 sources are registered' line; the ledger tally by matching the ledger with the parser's own CASE_HEADING regex and Status body key (67 cases, 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED) and by the verifier's own 'OK tally is 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED' line; the check count by an executed run printing '177/177 roadmap dashboard checks passed'. npm run verify:roadmap-dashboard and npm run verify:verifier-classification were both executed by the lease holder after the edit and passed (177/177 with the Overview banner still reading 'Sources agree'; 200 classified with 'classification reconciled'). git diff --check is clean. No verifier, parser or production source was altered to match the prose.
completion.qa_known_limitations: Only the roadmap and verifier-classification checks were run; this task deliberately did not re-run the full product battery, verify:security, verify:accent-gui, verify:branding-gui, the canvas verifiers or the reports verifiers, and did not run npm run build, because no executable code was changed — the only content edit is Markdown prose in tools/roadmap/README.md plus the TASK_LOG entry and control-plane bookkeeping. The carried state of those unrun checks is unchanged and is not re-asserted by this task. One further edit beyond the three corrected sentences was necessary and is disclosed: the 'What it reads' table enumerated only 13 sources with 2 unparsed rows, so correcting the prose to 14/3 without adding the missing docs/ai/contracts/active-lease.json row would have introduced a new self-contradiction; exactly one table row was added, sourced verbatim from that entry's own skipReason in lib/sources.mjs. Additional stale-looking figures elsewhere in the README (the 67-case, 34-defect, 101-row, 111-issue and 24-of-29 figures, and the 13-syscall poll figure, which is correct because the watcher excludes one registered source) were recorded and deliberately left unchanged to keep this tranche narrow.
